easy.q: What was Elder Hathaway's main message about Jesus Christ?
options: He delivers the righteous from every affliction of mortality
He keeps the righteous from ever having hard trials
He wants us to fix our troubles before we ask for help
easy.why: Elder Hathaway said, “My message today is that Jesus Christ delivers the righteous from these and every other affliction of mortality.” Trials still come, but the Savior delivers.

easy.q: What happened to Elder Hathaway's family as they drove to begin serving as mission leaders?
options: A snowstorm closed the freeway for the night
Large tires from a semitruck struck both of their cars
Both cars broke down far from the nearest town
easy.why: In a construction zone, two large tires came loose from a semitruck and hit both cars. The cars were destroyed, yet the family began their mission on time without serious injury.

easy.q: While the family was stranded on the roadside, what did the Spirit bring them?
options: A warning to turn around and go back home
An answer about why the accident had happened
Peace that everything would be all right
easy.why: Elder Hathaway said, “In that moment, the Spirit brought us peace: Everything would be all right.” That assurance gave them hope before the trial was over.

easy.q: In the scripture story Elder Hathaway told, whose daughter did the Savior deliver from death?
options: The daughter of King Darius
The daughter of Jairus
The daughter of Helaman
easy.why: Jairus held on to the Savior's words, “Be not afraid, only believe,” and watched Him deliver his daughter from death.

easy.q: According to Elder Hathaway, when will Jesus Christ deliver us?
options: In His own time and His own way
As soon as we ask Him in prayer
Only after this life is over
easy.why: Elder Hathaway promised, “In His time and way, Jesus Christ will deliver you.” Some miracles come right away, some after long waiting, and some at the Resurrection.

medium.q: According to Elder Hathaway, why does the Savior comprehend our suffering and know how to succor us?
options: He has watched over mortal sorrows from heaven since the beginning
He was shown every mortal life in vision before He came to earth
He suffered pains, afflictions, and temptations of every kind
He learned of mortal suffering from the prophets who served Him
medium.why: Elder Hathaway taught that Jesus Christ “descended below all things” and suffered afflictions of every kind; therefore He understands, is filled with mercy, and knows how to help us.

medium.q: Why did Elder Hathaway tell the story of his family's accident on the freeway?
options: To show that the faithful are shielded from serious accidents
To illustrate a scriptural pattern of divine deliverance
To teach that mission leaders must give up their possessions
To warn that opposition is strongest just before we serve
medium.why: He said the experience “illustrates a scriptural pattern of divine deliverance”: opposition, sincere seeking, assurances, enabled enduring, and deliverance in the Savior's time and way.

medium.q: What did Elder Hathaway say heartrending questions and deep emotions can create?
options: A weakness we must overcome before we can pray sincerely
A sign that our faith in the Savior has begun to fail
A burden that keeps the Spirit from bringing us peace
A sacred space where we choose whether to turn toward Christ
medium.why: He taught that such questions and emotions “can create a sacred space where agency is activated and we choose whether to turn toward Jesus Christ.”

medium.q: Elder Hathaway mentioned Alma's people crying mightily to God and King Darius fasting through the night. What were these examples of?
options: Sincere seeking, which draws us closer to Jesus Christ
Assurances given before any prayer was offered
Deliverance that came the moment it was requested
Opposition that falls on rulers and people alike
medium.why: Both are examples of sincere seeking: turning toward Heavenly Father and Jesus Christ through prayer, fasting, and scripture study. “Such acts of faith draw us closer to Jesus Christ.”

medium.q: According to Elder Hathaway, why might the Lord allow us to wait for deliverance?
options: Waiting shows whether we have earned His help
Waiting is the consequence of our past mistakes
Waiting can bring converting growth an earlier rescue might not
Waiting gives Him time to attend to those in greater need
medium.why: He testified that the Lord knows “lessons learned while waiting can bring converting growth that an earlier rescue might not produce.” He has not forgotten us.

hard.q: How did Elder Hathaway describe what the grace of Jesus Christ does for us in affliction?
options: It removes the pain once we have done all that we can do
It gives divine strength beyond our own without removing the pain
It replaces our effort, so that we need only stand still
It shortens the affliction in proportion to our faith
hard.why: He said, “This grace does not remove the pain and difficulty of affliction; it is an enabling power” that lets us receive divine strength beyond our own.

hard.q: Elder Hathaway said the Savior's deliverance is certain. For most righteous followers, then, what is the real question?
options: Whether they are righteous enough to be delivered
Why the affliction was allowed to come at all
Which afflictions He is willing to deliver them from
How and when He will deliver them
hard.why: Because Christ can deliver the righteous from all things, the question “is not if He will deliver but how and when He will do so.”

hard.q: A woman praying through a long illness feels peace that all will be well, though she is not yet healed. In Elder Hathaway's pattern, what has she received?
options: An assurance of deliverance
Deliverance in the Savior's time
A sign that her seeking may end
Proof that her trial is over
hard.why: Elder Hathaway taught that the Savior will visit us in our afflictions and “bring assurances of deliverance.” Such assurance gives peace and hope before deliverance itself comes.

hard.q: What did Elder Hathaway say the deliverance of Jairus's daughter shows?
options: Believing without fear brings deliverance before a loss is final
A parent's faith ensures that a child will be healed
No mortal timeline can place us beyond Christ's power to deliver
The greatest miracles are given to those who ask in person
hard.why: Jairus must have felt the time had passed, yet the Savior delivered his daughter, “showing that no mortal timeline can place us beyond Christ’s power to deliver.”

hard.q: Elder Hathaway taught that as we wait upon the Lord, the Savior delivers us from our afflictions and does what else with them?
options: Removes all memory of them
Consecrates them for our gain
Keeps them from ever returning
Uses them to measure our worth
hard.why: He taught that as growth and spiritual stretching come, the Savior “delivers us from our afflictions and consecrates them for our gain.” Our trials are not wasted.
